name: EVE Trader
install: for d in eve-trader repos/eve-trader /agent/repos/eve-trader .; do [ -f "$d/.cursor/install.sh" ] && { cd "$d"; break; }; done; bash .cursor/install.sh
start: for d in eve-trader repos/eve-trader /agent/repos/eve-trader .; do [ -f "$d/.cursor/start.sh" ] && { cd "$d"; break; }; done; bash .cursor/start.sh

terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: for d in eve-trader repos/eve-trader /agent/repos/eve-trader .; do [ -f "$d/.cursor/start.sh" ] && { cd "$d"; break; }; done; EVE_TRADER_PG_DSN='host=localhost port=5432 dbname=eve_trader_dev user=eve_trader_app password=app_devpassword' EVE_TRADER_PG_CONTAINER='' .venv/bin/uvicorn eve_trader.api.main:app --port 8000

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.command: for d in eve-trader repos/eve-trader /agent/repos/eve-trader .; do [ -f "$d/.cursor/start.sh" ] && { cd "$d"; break; }; done; cd frontend && npm run dev -- --host
